page.overview:
Who is Atom Eve?

Atom Eve is an Epic Outfit in Fortnite: Battle Royale, that can be purchased in the Item Shop for 1,500 V-Bucks or with the Guardians of the Globe Bundle for 2,800 V-Bucks. Atom Eve was first released in Chapter 4: Season OG and is part of the Guardians of the Globe Set. Category:Female Category:Superheroes Category:Fortnite

Also known as: Samantha Eve Wilkins.
